economic_hypothesis: Aggressive flow has positive expectancy only when its price response distinguishes informed pressure from absorption, fragmentation and impact-state transition. Trade count and average quote trade size separate many-small-order crowding from fewer-large-order pressure; price response per unit signed flow separates continuation from reversal.

data.selection: calendar 2023, physically opened only for one frozen development survivor per family
data.validation: calendar 2024, physically opened only for the same candidate after selection passage
data.source_rule: Every retained monthly ZIP was previously verified against the adjacent official CHECKSUM. Reuse is allowed only after the retained artifact hash inventory passes. Any later-stage acquisition must repeat adjacent CHECKSUM verification.
data.missing_data_rule: Use a regular UTC minute grid. Keep absent observations as NaN; no forward fill, backfill, interpolation, synthetic OHLC or timeline compression. Signals and orders require all relevant observed values and contiguous entry/exit bars.

information_boundary.features: Current one-minute bar values are usable only after that bar closes. Rolling means, standard deviations, volatility, beta and state references exclude the current observation.
information_boundary.entry: First contiguous USD-M one-minute open after the completed signal bar.
information_boundary.funding: Apply official funding events in (entry, exit] at recorded calc_time. Use the containing-minute official mark open; use the same-minute official contract open only when that mark observation is absent.
information_boundary.simultaneous_symbol_rule: Within a candidate, sort by signal timestamp, descending absolute registered score, then fixed symbol order BTCUSDT before ETHUSDT. One global account slot suppresses all later entries until the accepted position exits.

features.signed_taker_flow: (2 * taker_buy_quote - quote_volume) / quote_volume over the registered lag
features.average_quote_trade_size: sum quote_volume / sum trade_count over the registered lag
features.activity: prior-standardized log summed trade_count and log average quote trade size
features.return: log close-to-close return over the registered lag
features.prior_volatility: rolling standard deviation of one-minute log returns, shifted one completed bar
features.impact_efficiency: sign(signed_taker_flow) * lag return / (prior volatility * sqrt(lag) * max(abs(signed_taker_flow), 0.05))
features.impact_z: impact_efficiency standardized against a shifted 10,080-minute history with at least 4,320 observations
features.flow_activity_z: absolute signed flow standardized against the same shifted history
features.impact_delta: current impact_z minus the immediately preceding non-overlapping lag impact_z

families.name: aligned_high_impact_continuation
families.condition: flow_activity_z >= activity_z, abs(flow) >= min_abs_flow, impact_z >= impact_threshold

families.name: large_trade_aligned_continuation
families.condition: average_trade_size_z >= activity_z, abs(flow) >= min_abs_flow, impact_z >= impact_threshold

families.name: fragmented_flow_reversal
families.condition: trade_count_z >= activity_z, average_trade_size_z <= -0.5, abs(flow) >= min_abs_flow, impact_z <= -0.5 * impact_threshold

families.name: impact_decay_reversal
families.condition: previous impact_z >= activity_z, same flow sign across adjacent lag blocks, abs(flow) >= min_abs_flow, impact_delta <= -impact_threshold

families.name: impact_reacceleration_continuation
families.condition: previous impact_z <= -activity_z, same flow sign across adjacent lag blocks, abs(flow) >= min_abs_flow, impact_delta >= impact_threshold

grid.candidate_id: first 20 hex characters of SHA-256 over canonical sorted candidate JSON

execution.position: one USD-M perpetual position in one global BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT account slot
execution.risk: 0.5% of current NAV planned loss including a 26bp adverse reserve
execution.stop: max(stop_atr times prior ATR, 5bp of entry price)
execution.normal_exit: registered fixed hold at the exact contiguous one-minute open

freeze_rule: If any candidates pass development, freeze the single highest 18bp geometric-growth candidate per family; ties resolve by 18bp top-10%-removed return, lower 18bp drawdown, then candidate_id. Only those representatives may open 2023.
promotion_boundary: A basic-cost-positive raw candidate may be ranked if hard-valid and account-normalized, but no practical-use promotion is allowed without sequential passage, concentration robustness and later execution validation.
